title: 第11章 给个面子第12章 震惊四座
content_zh:
放下手里啤酒，江凡暗叹一声晦气，真是红颜祸水，神识外放，楼上的包厢是十多个聚会的白领，无奈神识范围只有一丈方圆，扫不到胖子所在的包厢。
三楼包厢，香江人，张兆庆、牧华伟暗暗皱眉，倒不是担心死胖子有什么大来头，而是三楼的大包厢可以容纳十多人，摇人可能有些来不及。
两人相视一眼，形势比人强，冒然上三楼可能会吃亏，牧华伟随即看向江凡，从容不迫说道：“江凡，麻烦你先带着她们离开帝豪……”
砰，牧华伟话语还未说完，包厢房门被人一脚踹开，七八个身着黑色西装壮汉气势汹汹走了进来，其中一个刀疤大汉冷冷扫了眼包厢众人，眼睛不由得一亮，五个清纯靓丽的极品女神，别说是精虫上脑的王老板，任何男人见到眼前美女都会见色起意吧。
刀疤男子随即扫向脸颊通红的张思雯，应该就是这位美女踹了王老板的裆部，再次扫向包厢内其他三个年轻人，问道：“刚才是你在卫生间踢人了吧？”
张兆庆上前一步，老子还没上去找你们算账，你们倒先下来兴师问罪，金陵的社团很牛逼嘛，不屑冷哼一声，“呵呵，刚才有个死胖子调戏我妹妹，老子还没去找你们，你们却反咬一口。”
“呵呵，初生牛犊不怕虎，年轻人很有种啊”
，刀疤男淡然一笑，很久没见过如此嚣张的年轻人，向兄弟使眼色让开路，随即玩味说道：“几位，请吧。”
张兆庆、牧华伟拦在众女身前，瞬间有些骑虎难下，他们两人去楼上无所谓，大不了被揍一顿，离开帝豪可以立即摇人找回场子，可众女要是跟着一块上去，极有可能惹出其他麻烦。
“怎么，刚才不是很嚣张，现在怂了”
，刀疤男冷笑一声，不屑扫了眼张兆庆和牧华伟，“怎么，需要老子亲自动手请你们？”
一众黑衣壮汉纷纷压起手指，手指关节咯吱作响，很是嚣张，一副准备动手绑人的动作。
众女皱起眉头，在夜店遇过不少次眼前的场面，无非就是有钱人的保镖，或是混社团的小瘪三，随便找个中间人化解眼前危机，有什么恩怨过后再解决……
“我们两人跟你们上去，有什么事冲我们来，放她们离开！”
牧华伟走向刀疤男子，内心一阵懊恼，应该先让众女离开这个是非之地，也不至于搞的如此被动。
“废话真多，兄弟们，动手。”
刀疤男嗤笑一声，老子是来找踢王老板的女人，放众女离开，你他喵的脑子秀逗了，还是喝傻逼了。
“别动”
，张兆庆和牧华伟快步拦住要动手的壮汉，风水轮流转，希望你能一直这么硬气，怒声说道：“好，我们跟你们上去，我倒是要瞧瞧，你们老板是何方神圣！”
一众黑衣壮汉惊动二楼包厢不少客人，倒是没有明目张胆对众人动手动脚，江凡摇头苦笑，轻拍李子茜肩膀，轻声说道：“没事，不用担心。”

“不好意思，连累你了，早知道发生这种破事也就不让你来KTV了。”
李子茜瞥了眼风轻云淡的江凡，不愧是被雷电劈过的男人，面对这种状况，依旧临危不乱，镇定自若。
见一行人离开，走廊看热闹的客人纷纷回到包厢，多一事不如少一事，可没几个人有胆子跟着去楼上看什么热闹，搞不好会被牵连无辜。
看着众人走向三楼末端的至尊包厢，甘永庆暗暗叫苦，情况有些不妙，至尊包厢里坐的肯定是秦淮区地下王者刘天虎，在金陵道上前五的存在，一个真正的超级狠人。
据说刘天虎八十年代在越南干掉数十个越兵，习惯了打打杀杀的生活，回到金陵也就混起了黑道，敢打敢杀，手段极为残忍，短短几年在秦淮区打下一片天地，在道上有着赫赫威名。
九六之后，刘天虎转型漂白上岸，明面上经营建材、装修等生意，实则还经营着不少娱乐场所和地下赌场，手下小弟有五六百人，这些年没少把生意上竞争对手沉江！
扫了眼那些瑟瑟发抖的体育生，甘永庆暗暗皱眉，其他女人的死活他不关心，可李子茜也进入刘天虎的包厢，搞不好会被刘天虎给玷污，那他甘永庆以后还怎么在金大混。
包厢众人纷纷看向甘永庆，那五个美女可全是自家金大的女神，他们倒是很想英雄救美救下众人，可那些黑衣壮汉明显就是道上混的，过去救人可能给自己招来无妄之灾。
甘永庆努力平复着畏惧情绪，双手颤抖着点燃一根香烟，狠狠抽了一口，老爸与刘天虎有些交情，踹胖子的不是李子茜，只保李子茜一人，应该没有多大的问题吧。
走进至尊包厢，包厢装修极为奢华，面积比中包大了三倍不止，江凡扫了眼满脸狰狞的胖子，又扫向坐在正位的中年人，颇有几分其实，大马金刀地坐在沙发上，连眼神也没有抬一下。
没人说话，包厢很是寂静，只有中年男人摇晃酒杯的声音，一众黑衣壮汉也不敢发出丝毫声音。

张兆庆和牧华伟扫了眼死胖子，又看向中年男人，一股上位者的威压，不过更多的是戾气，不用想也知道是道上混的大佬，事情有点难搞。
胖子震惊看向走进包厢的五位美女，各个清纯靓丽，堪称极品女神，简直就是人间尤物，丝毫不输于香江的那些女明星，禁不住咽了下口水，必须全部拿下，一个也不能放过。
“谁打了我的贵客，站出来吧。”
刘天虎摇晃着红酒杯，抬头扫了眼众人，五个小妞确实是人间尤物，难怪王胖子见色起意，恐怕没多少男人顶得住清纯美女的诱惑。
不待众人开口，包厢的房门被人敲响，甘永庆忐忑走进至尊包厢，扫了眼小白脸江凡，恨不得拿起红酒瓶给小白脸脑袋开瓢，见刘天虎不喜的眼神，浑身打了个哆嗦，颤颤巍巍说道：“刘叔，我爸是金丰地产的甘国泰，她们五女是小侄金大的同学，还请刘叔高抬贵手，放她们一马。”
呵呵，原来五位美女还是金大的高材生，刘天虎冷笑一声，不屑瞥了眼甘永庆，“甘国泰的儿子，就算你爹甘国泰在这，也不敢向我讨要面子，你小子胆子倒是不小，向我讨要面子？”
甘永庆暗暗叫苦，想要英雄救美必须付出点代价，心一狠，再次苦逼说道：“刘叔，里面有一位是小侄的女友，她与此件事情无关，还望刘叔放她一马。”

content_en:
Putting down the beer in his hand, Jiang Fan secretly sighed at the bad luck. Beauty is really a curse, and his spiritual consciousness was exposed. The box upstairs was occupied by more than ten white-collar workers at a party. Unfortunately, the range of his spiritual consciousness was only one foot in radius, and he could not scan the box where the fat man was.
In the private room on the third floor, Zhang Zhaoqing and Mu Huawei, who were from Xiangjiang, frowned secretly. It was not that they were worried about the fat man's great background, but that the large private room on the third floor could accommodate more than ten people, so it might be too late to shake people.
The two of them looked at each other. They were in a stronger position. If they went up to the third floor rashly, they might suffer a loss. Mu Huawei then looked at Jiang Fan and said calmly: "Jiang Fan, please take them away from Dihao first..."
Bang, before Mu Huawei finished speaking, the door of the private room was kicked open, and seven or eight strong men in black suits walked in aggressively. One of them, a big man with a scar, glanced coldly at everyone in the private room, and his eyes couldn't help but light up. Five pure and beautiful top goddesses, not to mention the sperm-addled Boss Wang, any man would be attracted by the beauty in front of him.
The man with the scar immediately glanced at Zhang Siwen, whose cheeks were red. She must have kicked Boss Wang in the crotch. He glanced at the other three young people in the box again and asked: "Did you kick someone in the bathroom just now?"
Zhang Zhaoqing took a step forward. I haven't gone up to you to settle the score yet, but you have come down to punish me first. The society in Jinling is very powerful. He snorted disdainfully, "Haha, there was a fat guy who teased my sister just now. I haven't gone to you yet, but you bit back."
"Haha, newborn calves are not afraid of tigers. Young people are very talented."
, the scarred man smiled indifferently. He had not seen such an arrogant young man for a long time. He winked at his brothers to get out of the way, and then playfully said: "Guys, please."
Zhang Zhaoqing and Mu Huawei stopped in front of the girls, and they were in a hurry. It didn't matter if they went upstairs, the worst they could do was get beaten up. They could immediately get back to the place after leaving Dihao, but if the girls followed them up together, they would most likely cause other troubles.
"Why, I wasn't very arrogant just now, but now I'm cowardly."
, the scarred man sneered, and glanced at Zhang Zhaoqing and Mu Huawei with disdain, "What, do you need me to invite you personally?"
A group of strong men in black pressed their fingers together, their knuckles creaking, and they were very arrogant, as if they were ready to tie someone up.
The girls frowned. They had encountered the scene in front of them many times in nightclubs. They were nothing more than rich people's bodyguards or gangsters, casually finding a middleman to resolve the immediate crisis, and settling any grievances later...
"The two of us will go up with you. If anything happens to us, let them go!"
Mu Huawei walked towards the scarred man, feeling annoyed in his heart. He should have let the girls leave this place of right and wrong first, and not be so passive.
"There's so much nonsense, brothers, do it."
The scarred man sneered, "I'm here to kick the woman who kicked Boss Wang, let the other girls leave. You're so smart, but you're still drunk."
"Don't move"
, Zhang Zhaoqing and Mu Huawei quickly stopped the strong man who was about to take action. The situation was changing. I hope you can always be so stubborn. They said angrily: "Okay, we will go up with you. I want to see who your boss is!"
A group of strong men in black alarmed many guests in the private room on the second floor, but they did not blatantly attack anyone. Jiang Fan shook his head and smiled bitterly, patted Li Ziqian on the shoulder, and said softly: "It's okay, don't worry."
"I'm sorry for causing trouble to you. If I had known that something like this happened, I wouldn't have let you come to the KTV."
Li Ziqian glanced at Jiang Fan, who was calm and calm. He was indeed a man who had been struck by lightning. Faced with this situation, he remained calm and composed despite the danger.
Seeing the group of people leaving, the guests who were watching the excitement in the corridor returned to their private rooms one after another. It was better to do less than to do more, but few people had the courage to follow them upstairs to watch the excitement, and they might be implicated.
Watching everyone walking towards the Supreme Bag at the end of the third floorIn the box, Gan Yongqing secretly complained that the situation was not good. The person sitting in the supreme box must be Liu Tianhu, the underground king of Qinhuai District, one of the top five on Jinling Road, a truly super ruthless person.
It is said that Liu Tianhu killed dozens of Vietnamese soldiers in Vietnam in the 1980s and became accustomed to the life of fighting and killing. When he returned to Jinling, he became involved in the underworld. He dared to fight and kill with extremely cruel methods. In just a few years, he established a world in Qinhuai District and gained a great reputation in the world.
After the 1996 Incident, Liu Tianhu transitioned into a business and went ashore. On the surface, he was engaged in building materials, decoration and other businesses. In fact, he also ran many entertainment venues and underground casinos. He had five to six hundred people under his command. In recent years, he has often brought business to his competitor Shen Jiang!
Glancing at the trembling sports students, Gan Yongqing frowned secretly. He didn't care about the lives of other women, but Li Ziqian also entered Liu Tianhu's box, and she might be defiled by Liu Tianhu. Then how could he, Gan Yongqing, hang out in Jin Da in the future.
Everyone in the box looked at Gan Yongqing. Those five beauties were all goddesses of their own family. They really wanted to be a hero and rescue the beauties and save everyone, but those strong men in black were obviously gangsters. If they saved people in the past, they might bring disaster to themselves.
Gan Yongqing tried his best to calm down his fear. He lit a cigarette with trembling hands and took a long puff. His father had some friendship with Liu Tianhu. It was not Li Ziqian who kicked the fat man, but Li Ziqian was the only one who kicked him. There shouldn't be much of a problem.
Entering the supreme box, the decoration of the box was extremely luxurious, and the area was more than three times larger than that of the middle box. Jiang Fan glanced at the fat man with a ferocious face, and then glanced at the middle-aged man sitting in the front seat. He was sitting on the sofa calmly, without even raising his eyes.
No one spoke, and the box was very quiet. There was only the sound of middle-aged men shaking wine glasses, and a group of strong men in black did not dare to make any sound.

Zhang Zhaoqing and Mu Huawei glanced at the fat man, and then looked at the middle-aged man. They felt the pressure of a superior, but more of a rage. They knew without thinking that he was a big boss on the road, and things were a bit difficult.
The fat man looked at the five beauties who entered the box in shock. They were all pure and beautiful, and could be called the best goddesses. They were simply stunners in the world, not inferior to those female stars in Xiangjiang. He couldn't help but swallowed his saliva. He had to take them all, and he couldn't let any of them go.
"Whoever hit my distinguished guest, please come forward."
Liu Tianhu shook the red wine glass, raised his head and glanced at everyone. The five girls were indeed stunners in the world. No wonder Fatty Wang became interested in seeing them. I am afraid not many men can withstand the temptation of pure beauties.
Before anyone could speak, there was a knock on the door of the box. Gan Yongqing walked into the supreme box anxiously, glanced at the pretty boy Jiang Fan, and wanted to pick up the red wine bottle and open the little boy's head. Liu Tianhu was not happy to see that. With eyes wide open, his whole body trembled, and he said tremblingly: "Uncle Liu, my father is Gan Guotai from Jinfeng Real Estate, and these five girls are classmates of my nephew Jin Da. I ask Uncle Liu to be noble and let them go."
Haha, it turns out that the five beauties are still the top students of Jin University. Liu Tianhu sneered and glanced at Gan Yongqing with disdain, "Son of Gan Guotai, even if your father Gan Guotai is here, you don't dare to ask for face from me. You are quite brave, asking for face from me?"
Gan Yongqing secretly complained that he had to pay a price if he wanted to be a hero to save the beauty. He felt cruel and said bitterly again: "Uncle Liu, there is a girlfriend who is my nephew. She has nothing to do with this matter. I hope Uncle Liu will let her go."
